newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields end lower, crown softens.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields end lower, crown softens.

text.p: 1415 GMT - Swedish debt yields ended lower on Monday and the yield curve steepened as a result of worries over the stock market fall.
Dealers said a flow from stocks into T-bills further increased the trend of steepening that started on Friday.
The crown weakened a bit in calm trade.
The market focus for Tuesday was on the German repo rate announcement and Fed's FOMC-meeting.
* Six month T-bill rate fell two basis points to 4.35 pct
* 10-year bond yield fell one basis point to 6.63 percent.
* Crown softened to 4.3785 to mark vs 4.3650 crowns on Friday.
